The Red Neon Blue Eye Rainbowfish, also known as Pseudomugil luminatus, is a stunning nano fish native to freshwater rivers and streams in New Guinea and Indonesia. They are a captivating addition to planted aquariums due to their vibrant colors and peaceful nature.

Both males and females grow to about 1 inch (2.5 cm) long.
Be sure to have the habitat ready before purchase.
Native to freshwater rivers and streams in New Guinea and Indonesia.
In the wild, they are found in densely vegetated areas. Replicate this environment in your tank with plenty of live plants and floating plants for cover.

• pH: They thrive in slightly acidic, soft water with a pH of 6.5 to 7.5.
  • TDS: Adaptable; they can be kept in tap water with a TDS in excess of 200.
  • Temperature: 18°C to 26°C (64.4°F to 78.8°F).

They are omnivores and enjoy a varied diet of high-quality flake food supplemented with small live or frozen foods like brine shrimp, daphnia, and bloodworms. Their mouths are tiny, so ensure the food is appropriately sized.
Males boast vibrant red-orange bodies with electric blue accents, particularly on their fins. Females are a more subdued silver with a hint of blue.
